==Ingredients==
* 1 package (8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) croissant roll dough
* 24 slices of [[Cookbook:Pepperoni|pepperoni]]
* 4 slices of [[Cookbook:Provolone Cheese|provolone cheese]]
* Pizza spices as desired ([[Cookbook:Anise|anise]], [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]], [[Cookbook:Fennel|fennel]], [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]], etc.)

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F]].
# Unroll 2 croissant rolls and place together on ungreased [[Cookbook:Cookie Sheet|cookie sheet]], pointing in opposite directions, forming a rectangle by pinching sides together.
# Lay 6 slices of pepperoni on top of each dough rectangle.
# Lay a slice of provolone cheese on top of pepperoni slices.
# Roll each into a tube.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 12–15 minutes.
